summary: Tables start with no borders. Add borders and padding to the cells, and use border-collapse so neighboring borders become single lines.
notes: border-collapse: collapse goes on the table, not on the cells.
text-align: right on td lines up the digits of the scores.
thead th matches only header cells inside thead, so the row headers in tbody keep a white background.
pitfall: Putting the border on table only. That draws one outline around the outside and no lines between cells.
